newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador April inflation 0.1 percent - ministry.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador April inflation 0.1 percent - ministry.

text.p: Inflation in El Salvador for the month of April was 0.1 percent, the Economy Ministry said Tuesday.
March inflation was 0.2 percent over levels recorded in February, the ministry added.
Accumlated inflation so far in 1997 totaled 2.4 percent, down from the 2.7 percent inflation in the first four months of 1996, the ministry said. Year-on-year inflation was 7.1 percent.
"Inflation continues to abate, with the April figure the lowest monthly figure so far this year," the ministry added.
The government expects inflation for the year to end between five and seven percent. Prices in 1996 rose 7.4 percent.
